They use phishing emails to deliver weaponized Microsoft Excel documents, and most of their malware infect the target system with VisualBasic and PowerShell (.ps1) scripts. Between 2014 to 2016, the group's attack campaigns targeted banks and technology organizations in Saudi Arabia with phishing emails that included weaponized Microsoft Excel attachments.
